title: The otter
text: Day {day}, {city}. An animal cafe. A sea otter with the eyes of a saint and the teeth of a can opener presses its paws to the glass and looks at you. Specifically at you. The handler nods toward the open tank.

choices.label: Pet the otter
choices.text: You pet the otter. It was worth it. Three days later the cut on your finger is hot and the fever arrives at 3 am. The hospital is very clean and very confused.

choices.label: Pet it, clean the cut after
choices.text: You pet the otter. It was worth it. That night you clean the nick on your finger, and when it goes hot two days later the antibiotics are already in the backpack. You keep your week.

choices.label: Keep your hands to yourself
choices.text: You do not pet the otter. The otter does not forgive you. Neither do you.

title: Something gives
text: Lifting the bag onto the train rack, something in your lower back makes a sound you did not know it could make. For the next ten days, standing up is a project.

title: Baggage carousel, one wheel short
text: Your suitcase comes around the carousel on three wheels and a stump. The airline offers a form. The form offers nothing.

title: Delayed baggage
text: Everyone else's bag comes out. Yours is, according to the app, still in {city}'s departure city, having a nice time. Whatever was in it is somewhere else for a while.

title: The kettle
text: The collapsible travel kettle boils, then does not stop, then does something between boiling and detonation. Second-degree burns across the wrist. The hotel has a kettle. It always had a kettle.

title: Food poisoning
text: Day {day}, {city}. Something you ate has opinions. You spend two days learning the bathroom tile pattern by heart.
mitigatedText: Day {day}, {city}. Something you ate has opinions. The probiotics have counter-arguments. One rough night, not two days.

title: Cancelled on arrival
text: You land in {city}. The Airbnb host has cancelled 'due to unforeseen circumstances', which is to say a better booking. It is 6 pm and everything you own is on your back.

choices.label: Hotel across town
choices.text: A real bed, a real desk, a lost day of admin and a taxi that takes the scenic route.

choices.label: Hostel dorm tonight
choices.text: Six strangers, one snorer, a locker your laptop barely fits in. You live.

choices.label: Airport floor
choices.text: You know the airport. The airport knows you. Neither of you sleeps.

title: Left behind
text: Two hours out of {city} you realize your {item} is still in the room. The host 'will look'. The host does not look.
mitigatedText: You do the packing-cube count before you leave {city}. Everything has a place; everything is in its place.

title: The swarm
text: Sunset in {city}. The mosquitoes arrive like a shift change. You wake up with a constellation on each ankle and the sleep of a hunted animal.
mitigatedText: Sunset in {city}. The mosquitoes arrive. The net goes up and the repellent goes on. You sleep like a person with a plan.

title: Thin air
text: Above 3,500 m in {city} the headache starts behind the eyes and the appetite leaves. Slowly, slowly: the only rule up here.
mitigatedText: Above 3,500 m in {city}. Diamox tingles in your fingers, electrolytes in the bottle, a rest day in the plan. The headache stays a rumour.

title: Jet lag
text: Six or more time zones in one leg. For three days you are awake at 4 am and asleep in meetings. The body keeps its own calendar.
mitigatedText: Six or more time zones in one leg. Sleep mask down, earplugs in, sun lamp on at 7. The body grumbles and gets in line.

title: Wind day
text: The wind arrives at 2 pm like a train timetable. Everyone in {city} disappears to the water.
mitigatedText: The wind arrives at 2 pm like a train timetable. You rig up. Best day of the month.

title: Lost phone
text: Somewhere between the metro and the bar in {city}, your phone stops being yours. The plan you wrote for this exact moment is, of course, on the phone.
mitigatedText: Somewhere in {city} your phone stops being yours. The spare phone comes out of the backpack, the YubiKey logs you back in. A bad evening instead of a bad week.

title: Check-in scale
text: The airline scale reads a number and the agent reads it back to you like a diagnosis. Fifty pounds is fifty pounds.

title: Sea urchin
text: A reef, a wave, a foot in the wrong place. Seven spines and a limp for the rest of the week.
mitigatedText: A reef, a wave, a foot in the wrong place. Tweezers, antiseptic, done before dinner.

title: Rockfall
text: On the ferrata above {city} a stone the size of a fist comes down the gully. The helmet earns its rental fee.

title: Oktoberfest
text: Opening weekend. A tent, a Mass, another Mass, a brass band that will not stop. You lose a day and gain a story.

title: It rains
text: It rains in {city}. Not dramatically. Continuously. Everything you own is slightly damp.
mitigatedText: It rains in {city}. The shell goes on. You are the only dry person at the bus stop.

title: Sunburn
text: You forgot the sunscreen for exactly one afternoon. Your shoulders will remember it for a week.
mitigatedText: SPF 30 in the morning, SPF 32 at noon. The sun tries; the routine wins.

title: The upstairs neighbour
text: The Airbnb above yours in {city} is either a nightclub or a family of tap dancers. 3 am, 4 am, 5 am.
mitigatedText: The Airbnb above yours is a nightclub. Earplugs in. You hear nothing until the alarm.

title: Wildlife
text: A moose, or a stag, or something with more legs than expected, stands in the trail outside {city} and does not move. Neither do you. Best minute of the month.

title: A good day
text: Day {day}, {city}. Nothing goes wrong. The coffee is right, the light is right, the work gets done by two and the mountain is still there at three. This is why.

title: No wifi
text: The listing said wifi. The listing meant a router, unplugged, in a drawer. You hotspot the phone and pray to the tower on the hill.

title: The laundromat
text: The laundromat in {city} returns everything except one sock and your favourite t-shirt. Neither is ever seen again.

title: The host
text: Your host in {city} leaves bread, cheese and a handwritten map of the neighbourhood. The map is wrong and the cheese is perfect.

title: Someone you know
text: A friend from two cities ago is, by coincidence, in {city} this week. Dinner turns into a weekend.

title: Delayed
text: The flight to {city} boards, sits, deboards, and then leaves four hours late. You learn the gate area's every outlet.

title: Upgraded
text: At the gate the agent looks at you, looks at the screen, and hands you a new boarding pass. Row two. You do not ask why.

title: The window seat
text: The train to {city} runs along a lake, then a valley, then a lake again. You get nothing done and regret none of it.

title: One cable short
text: The Garmin cable is in the last hotel. The watch dies on day three and you become a person who does not know how far they walked.
mitigatedText: Every cable has a pouch and every pouch has a place. You leave {city} with all of them.

title: A real gym
text: {city} has a real gym, with real weights, and a day pass costs less than a coffee. Arm day, finally.

title: The cafe
text: You find the cafe in {city}. Not a cafe: the cafe. You will structure the rest of the stay around it.

title: Running low
text: Everything in the bag has been worn twice. You rotate the least offensive shirt to the front and hope for a laundromat.
